Long-Limbed Build.description:
💪 Build: Long-Limbed Build
Extended reach with arms and legs that are noticeably longer than average for the frame. Creates a distinctive silhouette and natural reach advantage.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Long-Limbed Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Long-limbed frame — arms and legs extending with unusual reach, hands and feet proportionally large. The limbs dominate the silhouette. Female: narrow shoulders with long arms, long slim neck, fine jaw, a light chest line on a long torso. Male: wider shoulders with long arms, long neck, defined jaw, a flat chest on a long torso. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure with extended reach.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
